modifications: The original is unmodified. Prepared data filters NRW GF=4 municipalities, joins official NUTS2 assignments and stores compact municipal/regional tables.
nuts_compatibility: All 59 NRW NUTS1/2/3 classifications unchanged in Eurostat 2013–2016, 2016–2021 and 2021–2024 amendment workbooks; all 396 municipal representative points agree with biomass regional assignments.
distribution: Original and prepared files remain local/ignored, separate from code and the Fordatis six-file resource bundle. Preparation generates a companion manifest containing the actual derived checksum.
